[FACT] User has been meal prepping every Sunday.  
[FACT] User wakes up early on Sundays to make a big batch of rice and portions it out into individual containers for the week.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new recipe ideas for meal prep.  
[PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in the lentil curry idea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their meal prep success and provided suggestions for protein sources that pair well with rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a lentil curry recipe that serves 4-6 people, including cooking time and ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The lentil curry recipe includes:  
- 1 cup brown or green lentils, rinsed and drained  
- 2 medium onions, chopped  
- 3 cloves of garlic, minced  
- 1 medium carrot, chopped  
- 1 can (14 oz) diced tomatoes  
- 2 cups vegetable broth  
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin  
- 1 teaspoon curry powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon turmeric  
- 1/2 teaspoon paprika  
- Salt and pepper, to taste  
- Optional: 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (for some heat)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the lentil curry include cooking onions, garlic, and spices, adding lentils and broth, and simmering until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested adding diced mango to the curry for sweetness and flavor, recommending to add it during the last 10-15 minutes of cooking.  
[PREFERENCE] User is excited to try the lentil curry recipe with mango.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided suggestions on how to incorporate lentil curry into the user's meal prep routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended labeling and dating containers, using a "first in, first out" system, and keeping containers organized.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of experimenting with different spices and herbs to add more flavor to their meal prep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended popular spice blends and individual spices that pair well with lentils and rice, including:
